context.body: Priestly blessing and prepared sacrifice culminate in divine fire and communal response.
context.label: Narrative or literary frame

observations.body: The LORD’s glory appears and fire consumes the offering on the altar.
observations.label: Fire comes from before the LORD: action

observations.body: The people shout and fall on their faces.
observations.label: Fire comes from before the LORD: response

observations.body: glory appeared · fire came out · consumed · fell
observations.label: Words in Leviticus 9:22–24

payload.posture: Read Leviticus 9:22–24 as presence in the wilderness evidence before carrying it into another source.
payload.tension: The fire signifies acceptance here, but nearby priestly fire can also become judgment.
payload.title: Fire comes from before the LORD
